article.title: Qingming Festival
article.text: Qingming Festival is a time for families to remember their ancestors. Many people visit family tombs, clean the area, and bring flowers. Some families eat green rice balls made with sticky rice and mugwort. Children may also go outside and fly kites in the spring weather.
article.translation: 清明節是家人追思祖先的日子。許多人會到家族墓地掃墓、整理周圍並帶花祭拜。有些家庭會吃以糯米和艾草製作的青糰。孩子們也可能趁著春天的天氣到戶外放風箏。
